remarks: Beautifully renovated one-bedroom condominium with a private balcony in the desirable Glenrock community. **Recent renovations include a brand-new kitchen with modern cabinetry, countertops, and stainless steel appliances, new luxury vinyl flooring throughout, a newly tiled bathroom floor with an updated vanity, and fresh paint throughout, creating a truly move-in-ready home. **Conveniently located within the complex, this unit also offers a private garage with an automatic door opener and a separate lower-level storage room. Enjoy low-maintenance living with beautifully landscaped grounds, an in-ground swimming pool, and an affordable HOA. **Ideally situated for commuters, the property is within walking distance to the Metro-North train station on Glover Avenue and offers quick access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, shopping, restaurants, parks, and Norwalk's beaches. **Whether you're a first-time home buyer, downsizing, or looking for an easy lifestyle, this updated home offers exceptional value in a sought-after location.
